require "version"

# Combination of a version and a revision.
class PkgVersion

  extend Forwardable

  REGEX = /\A(.+?)(?:_(\d+))?\z/
  private_constant :REGEX

  sig { returns(Version) }
  attr_reader :version

  sig { returns(Integer) }
  attr_reader :revision

  delegate [:major, :minor, :patch, :major_minor, :major_minor_patch] => :version

  sig { params(path: String).returns(PkgVersion) }
